sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Agent Reach gives AI agents access to parts of the internet they normally can't reach, such as Bilibili, YouTube subtitles, V2EX, GitHub issues, Reddit, X and Xiaohongshu. It installs and tests the tools behind each platform so the agent can use them with one command.
sixtySeconds.problem: Agents like Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and OpenClaw can search the web and read pages, but struggle with logged-in features, video content, Chinese platforms and clean structured data. Agent Reach sets up a channel for each platform.
whoFor: Users of Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent or OpenClaw
People who research on Chinese platforms like Bilibili, Xiaohongshu or V2EX
Anyone who wants video subtitles or podcast transcripts in their agent
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if your agent needs specific platforms that normal web search covers poorly. Experimental channels like X, Facebook and Instagram may stop working as platforms tighten anti-scraping, and you should follow each platform's terms.
requirements: An AI agent that can run commands
uv (the agent installs it if missing)
Logins for platforms that need them
A Groq or OpenAI key for speech-to-text

overview: Agent Reach adds channels to your agent. Default channels work right after install: Bilibili (search, video info, trending, subtitles), V2EX, GitHub (repos, READMEs, issues and PRs), YouTube (info, search, subtitles, transcription) and general web search and reading.

Optional channels are added by asking your agent, for example 'add Xiaohongshu': Xiaohongshu, Xueqiu stock data, Boss job listings, Xiaoyuzhou podcasts, LinkedIn jobs and Reddit. Experimental channels for X, Facebook and Instagram work but may break at any time.

For sites that need login, Agent Reach uses its own dedicated browser running in the background. The first time you use a site it copies that site's login from your Chrome; your original browser is unchanged and it doesn't read passwords. The README warns that the agent-reach package on PyPI is not this project.

features.body: YouTube and Bilibili subtitles, speech-to-text for videos and podcasts.

features.title: Structured data
features.body: Clean posts, replies, issues and stock quotes.

features.title: Auto channel picking
features.body: agent-reach read chooses the channel from a link.

features.title: Works with any agent
features.body: Installs through a single instruction to your agent.

strengths: One install for many hard-to-reach platforms
Agent installs and tests everything itself
limitations: Experimental channels can break at any time
Logged-in channels reuse your browser logins
Transcription needs a Groq or OpenAI key
README is mainly in Chinese (English version available)
